notes: CHEESE farming system on Sepolia. CheeseEmissionController(owner_, squeekCore_, treasury_): owner and initial guardian are $owner; squeekCore_ is the verified official SqueekCore proxy 0xFD6C166D4B8E2962E65746a13e5a0797CD4dE0c4 (release core-sepolia-20261103), whose block counter drives emission on SQK's exact schedule (launch bonus plus halvings); treasury_ is $owner because the brief names no Treasury wallet (the owner can change it with setTreasury). The constructor makes no external call. CheeseToken(teamRecipient_, treasuryRecipient_, liquidityRecipient_, emissionAuthority_): CHEESE/CHEESE, 18 decimals, 2.1B lifetime cap. The SQK-mirroring 210M premint goes to $owner for all three recipients because the brief names no wallets. The immutable emission authority is the controller, and the token has no owner mint. CheeseFarmERC20(owner_, controller_, asset_) is the CHEESE pool farm, with CheeseToken as its asset. CheeseFarmETH(owner_, controller_) is the native ETH farm. CheeseFarmSIMD(owner_, controller_) is the sIMD farm; the owner sets its asset once after launch, and it must be a static-balance (non-rebasing) ERC-20. Farms charge the 15% Hamster Bite on withdrawal (85% to the user, 14% retained, 1% to Treasury, all 15% to Treasury if no shares remain). Owner steps after launch (see the README): bindToken(CheeseToken); addPool CHEESE 400, ETH 200, sIMD 200, which leaves 200 of the 1000 points as the inactive Future Pool Reserve; CheeseFarmSIMD.setAsset(sIMD); then activate() after running script/VerifySqueekchain.s.sol. The owner cannot move user principal or accrued rewards.
